edits.old_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch,
edits.new_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth; its ruling also says whether it takes a spec campaign (umbrellas.md § Review). On the ruling, or when that campaign closes, it lands at once on its own branch,

note: Binding-change paragraph: the decision ask's ruling now also says whether the change takes a spec campaign, and landing waits for that campaign to close where one is ruled.
